title: Adding previewExitFor to IYieldStrategy breaks four non-AYieldStrategy implementers at the next submodule bump
description: story-050 declares previewExitFor on IYieldStrategy.sol:79. Four implementers across two sibling repos resolve IYieldStrategy through a remapping to the LIVE reflax submodule — no repo vendors its own copy — so all four become non-abstract contracts missing an interface member and fail to compile at the next bump.
impact: Build break in TEST suites only, not a runtime break. Enumeration run untruncated over every registered top-level submodule at its own HEAD, excluding nested lib/**: stable-staker/test/Migration.t.sol:924 (UnderRealizingStrategy), stable-staker/test/mocks/MockYieldStrategy.sol:26, stable-yield-accumulator/test/StableYieldAccumulator.t.sol:112 and :215. Exactly four. phoenix-phase-2-staging has ZERO code implementers (its only hit is a markdown plan document); antimatter's mock declares no interface inheritance and is unaffected.
attackPath: stable-staker or stable-yield-accumulator bumps its lib/reflax-yield-vault pin to cdd0743 or later.
Its test contracts implementing IYieldStrategy no longer implement every member.
solc reports 'Contract ... should be marked as abstract' and the test suite fails to build.
recommendation: Add a previewExitFor stub to each of the four test implementers as part of the bump, or make the interface member optional by moving it to a separate extension interface.
whyNotSpeculation: 'Speculation on future code without a demonstrated root cause' tested and REJECTED. The rule's operative words are WITHOUT A DEMONSTRATED ROOT CAUSE. Everything material exists today: the declaration is at IYieldStrategy.sol:79 at cdd0743; the four implementers exist at their own current HEADs; and the consequence is mechanically determined (a non-abstract contract missing an interface member does not compile). Only the DATE is future (the next submodule bump), not the mechanism.
loadBearingFact: THIS FINDING CARRIES THE RUN'S LOAD-BEARING FACT: previewExitFor has ZERO CONSUMERS. Verified THREE times independently and untruncated — dedup (grep -rn 'previewExitFor' lib/ hits only under reflax-yield-vault/), the symbolic pass (per-submodule counts re-derived), and the severity audit (antimatter 0, phlimbo-ea 0, phoenix-nft-staking 0, phoenix-phase-2-staging 0, stable-staker 0, stable-yield-accumulator 0, yield-claim-nft 0, reflax-yield-vault 32) across all nine top-level submodule HEADs. This is the fact holding L-18..L-22 at Low.
escalationTrigger: MR-17-04. story-faithfulness WATCH-17-01 claims SIX implementers; two are in UNREGISTERED repos and outside this run's evidence base (phusd-stable-minter/test/PhusdStableMinter.t.sol:66 and deployment-staging/src/mocks/MockYieldStrategy.sol:12). The second matters disproportionately: its citation places it in src/, NOT test/, which would escalate a test-only break to a DEPLOYABLE-CONTRACT break => Low or Medium. The enumeration DOES NOT ASSERT IT EXISTS; it flags the claim as unverifiable. REGISTER deployment-staging OR CONFIRM IT IS DEAD BEFORE THE NEXT REFLAX BUMP.
watchNote: WATCH-17-03 — one stable-staker submodule bump escalates L-18..L-22 at once, and coincides with the F-03 and F-16-003 Medium re-evaluation gates. Handle in ONE PASS.
